description: Parse ATM Electronic Journal log lines (NCR + GRG, legacy and current shapes) into a structured nested schema: atm.id, terminal.id, transaction.*, card.masked, fault.*, event.category. Referenced by filebeat.yml (output.elasticsearch.pipeline). v2 replaces flat field output; raw message is always retained by filebeat.

patterns: ^%{TIMESTAMP_ISO8601:event_time} \| %{DATA:atm.id} \| %{DATA:terminal.id} \| %{DATA:event.category} \| %{DATA:transaction.type} \| SEQ=%{DATA:transaction.sequence} \| CARD=%{DATA:card.masked} \| AMOUNT=%{NUMBER:transaction.amount:float} \| CURRENCY=%{DATA:transaction.currency} \| STATUS=%{DATA:transaction.status}(\| AUTH=%{DATA:transaction.auth_code})?$

^%{TIMESTAMP_ISO8601:event_time} \| %{DATA:atm.id} \| %{DATA:terminal.id} \| VENDOR=%{DATA:vendor} \| TXN_CODE=%{DATA:transaction.type} \| SEQ=%{DATA:transaction.sequence} \| ACCT_NO=%{DATA:card.masked} \| AMOUNT=%{NUMBER:transaction.amount:float} \| CURRENCY=%{DATA:transaction.currency} \| RESP_CODE=%{DATA:transaction.status}(\| AUTH(_CODE)?=%{DATA:transaction.auth_code})?$
